packageRules.description: Upgrade the Vite+ toolchain with `vp upgrade` and `vp migrate`, because these versions must move together
The oxc crates share types such as `Span` and `Allocator`, so they must move together
vize releases several times a day; update it once a week
The vize update can only start in its weekly window, so do not let the limits on open PRs hold it back
